title: Pablo Alborán To Bring ‘Global Tour KM0’ to the U.S. in 2027: Check Out the Dates
summary: The announcement comes as the artist recovers from "severe pneumonia" that led him to cancel a recent concert in Spain.
contentText:
Spanish artist Pablo Alborán will bring his Global Tour KM0 to the U.S. in 2027. The acclaimed singer-songwriter will kick off the trek on Feb. 6 in Miami and make stops in cities including New York, Washington, D.C. and Los Angeles, before concluding on Feb. 21 in Dallas.

The announcement comes as Alborán recovers from a “severe pneumonia” that forced him to cancel his Aug. 21 show in Ciudad Real, Spain.

“I have just been diagnosed with severe pneumonia, and on medical advice, I need complete rest for the next few days,” he wrote in a post on his Instagram account last Thursday (Aug. 20). “I’ve already started a round of antibiotics that will have me back to normal in no time.”

Billboard Español  has reached out to the artist’s representatives for an update on his health.

Tickets for the U.S. leg of the tour — presented by Emporio Group Entertainment — will be available starting Friday (Aug. 28) via Ticketmaster , except for the Dallas date, whose tickets will be sold on AXS.com .

Alborán is currently in the middle of his KM0 world tour, which has already covered parts of Latin America and Spain, where he played to sold-out crowds in cities including Barcelona, Madrid and Valencia. His next performance is scheduled for Aug. 30 at the Festival de la Luz in Baimoro, Spain, according to his website . In September, Alborán plans to return to Latin America, starting in Costa Rica on the 27th, followed by stops in El Salvador, Panama, Mexico and Puerto Rico.

The trek supports his latest album  KM0 , a deeply personal project born out of the pain and uncertainty caused by a loved one’s illness, as the artist  shared in an interview  with  Billboard . Released last November, the set was included in  Billboard ‘s list of the 25 Best Latin Albums of 2025 .

Check out all the U.S. dates for Pablo Alborán’s Global Tour KM0 below:

- Feb. 6: Miami, Fla. @ Kaseya Center

- Feb. 7: Orlando, Fla. @ KIA Center

- Feb. 9: Atlanta, Ga. @ Coca-Cola Roxy

- Feb. 11: New York, N.Y. @ Radio City Music Hall

- Feb. 14: Washington, D.C. @ DAR Constitution Hall

- Feb. 18: Los Angeles, Calif. @ YouTube Theater

- Feb. 20: Houston, Texas @ 713 Music Hall

- Feb. 21: Dallas, Texas @ Texas Trust CU Theatre
